env.description: This is an object of keys that represent different environments. For example, you may have: `{ env: { production: { /* specific options */ } } }` which will use those options when the environment variable BABEL_ENV is set to "production". If BABEL_ENV isn't set then NODE_ENV will be used, if it's not set then it defaults to "development"

assumptions.description:
Assumptions that Babel can make in order to produce smaller output
https://babeljs.io/docs/options#assumptions

ast.description: Include the AST in the returned object

auxiliaryCommentAfter.description: Attach a comment after all non-user injected code.

auxiliaryCommentBefore.description: Attach a comment before all non-user injected code.

babelrc.description:
Whether to search for .babelrc.json files relative to the file being compiled. Only allowed in the root config file
https://babeljs.io/docs/options#babelrc

babelrcRoots.description:
Packages that should be considered root packages when deciding whether to load their .babelrc.json files. Only allowed in the root config file
https://babeljs.io/docs/options#babelrcroots

browserslistConfigFile.description:
Whether to use browserslist config sources, or the path of a browserslist configuration file
https://babeljs.io/docs/options#browserslistconfigfile

compact.description: Do not include superfluous whitespace characters and line terminators. When set to "auto" compact is set to true on input sizes of >500KB.

exclude.description:
If any of these patterns match, the current configuration object is ignored
https://babeljs.io/docs/options#exclude

extends.description: A path to a .babelrc file to extend

filename.description: Filename for use in errors etc.

generatorOpts.description:
An object containing the options to be passed down to the Babel code generator
https://babeljs.io/docs/options#generatoropts

highlightCode.description: ANSI highlight syntax error code frames

inputSourceMap.description: If true, attempt to load an input sourcemap from the file itself. If an object is provided, it will be treated as the source map object itself.

minified.description:
Like compact, but also omits block-end semicolons, () from new Foo() when possible, and may output shorter versions of literals
https://babeljs.io/docs/options#minified

moduleId.description: Specify a custom name for module ids.

moduleIds.description: If truthy, insert an explicit id for modules. By default, all modules are anonymous. (Not available for common modules)

moduleRoot.description: Optional prefix for the AMD module formatter that will be prepend to the filename on module definitions. (defaults to "sourceRoot")

only.description: A glob, regex, or mixed array of both, matching paths to only compile. Can also be an array of arrays containing paths to explicitly match. When attempting to compile a non-matching file it's returned verbatim.

overrides.description:
An array of options that are merged into the current configuration one at a time, usually combined with test, include and exclude
https://babeljs.io/docs/options#overrides

parserOpts.description:
An object containing the options to be passed down to the Babel parser
https://babeljs.io/docs/options#parseropts

passPerPreset.description:
Instructs Babel to run each of the presets in the presets array as an independent pass
https://babeljs.io/docs/options#passperpreset

plugins.description: List of plugins to load and use

presets.description: List of presets (a set of plugins) to load and use

retainLines.description: Retain line numbers. This will lead to wacky code but is handy for scenarios where you can't use source maps. NOTE: This will obviously not retain the columns.

sourceFileName.description: Set sources[0] on returned source map. (defaults to "filenameRelative")

sourceMaps.description: If truthy, adds a map property to returned output. If set to "inline", a comment with a sourceMappingURL directive is added to the bottom of the returned code. If set to "both" then a map property is returned as well as a source map comment appended.

sourceMapTarget.description: Set file on returned source map. (defaults to "filenameRelative")

sourceRoot.description: The root from which all sources are relative. (defaults to "moduleRoot")

sourceType.description:
Whether files are parsed as scripts, ES modules or CommonJS, or detected from their import/export statements
https://babeljs.io/docs/options#sourcetype

targets.description:
The environments you support, as a browserslist query, a list of queries, or an object of minimum versions
https://babeljs.io/docs/options#targets

test.description:
If all of these patterns fail to match, the current configuration object is ignored
https://babeljs.io/docs/options#test

title: JSON schema for Babel 6+ configuration files
